Name: Stoner Valley
Author: BongWaterrr
Description:
[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]7 strains of weed to grow, including one during winter. (Possibly more to come, see note at the bottom)[/size]
[*][size=2]7 new THC-infused cooking recipes.[/size]
[*][size=2]4 new machines.[/size]
[*][size=2]4 new artisan goods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Process your weed into blunts, package it into jars, concentrate it into a fine wax, or melt it down into cannabutter.[/size]
[*][size=2]New location in the mountains to purchase cannabis seeds.[/size]
[*][size=2]A new NPC, Bizz! You can buy the new seeds from his trailer once the railroad has been unlocked.[/size]
[*][size=2]Gift your weed and weed products to villagers. [/size]
[*][size=2]Sell your products for high profit![/size]
[*][size=2]Powerful end-game item available to purchase at the trailer after meeting Leo on Ginger Island.[/size]
[*][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]NOTE:

[/size][/b][size=2]I am not a programmer or an artist, this mod was more of a passion project for me. Most of the coding / art knowledge I currently have came from learning how to create this mod. That being said, if you think you can make better art or have any overall suggestions, please leave a comment! I'm more than happy to work with anyone to help make this the best it can be. I'll gladly keep this updated upon request, and maybe add more strains / features if people like it! That's all for now, thanks for trying it out! :)[/size]

Downloads.Description:
- To make things a little more personal/customized, Fizz is now known as Bizz, Fizz's twin brother!
- Fixed the issue of Bizz not being giftable or showing up in the friends tab.
- Bizz's friendship is now required for perfection.
